scenario modem_unsynced

send mx wake addr=0x30010 data=7 sync=0
send mx sleep addr=0x30010 data=7 sync=0

send cx wake addr=0x30000 data=7 sync=0
send cx sleep addr=0x30000 data=7 sync=0

st cx_ao corner=0 active=7 enabled=0

st mss corner=7 active=7 enabled=1
end
